definitions.short: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
definitions.usage: deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.
definitions.full: H7832. sachaq שָׂחַק verb laugh (|| צהק , q. v.; Late Hebrew סָחַק שָׂחַק, ; Ethiopic ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳וְשׂ consecutive Prov 29:9 ; 3 plural שָֽׂחֲקוּ Lam 1:7 ; Job 30:1 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׂחַק 39:7 +, etc.; Infinitive construct שְׂחוֺק Judg 16:24 ; Eccl 3:4 ; — 1. a. laugh at, usually in contempt, derision, with עַל person Job 30:1 ; Psa 52:8 ; עַל of thing Lam 1:7 with ל person God subject Psa 37:13 ; 59:9 (|| לָעַג ); with ל of thing or person= have no fear of, Hab 1:10 ; Job 5:22 ; Prov 31:25 also, figurative, of noble animals Job 39:7 , 18 , 22 ; 41:21 ; absolute, Prov 29:9 (opposed to רָגַז ), of ׳י Psa 2:4 (|| לָעֵג ), of wisdom Prov 1:26 ( ב temporal; || id. ). b. with אֶל person, apparently of friendly laugh Job 29:24 ; in General Eccl 3:4 (opposed to בָּכָה ). 2 sport, play , Judg 16:27 . Pi`el Perfect 1singular וְשִׂחַקְתִּ֫י 1Sam 6:21 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְשַׂחֶקֿ Judg 16:25 , etc.; Infinitive construct לְשֵׂחֶקֿ Psa 104:26 ; Participle מְשַׂחֵק Prov 26:19 ; 1Chr 15:29 , feminine מְשֵׂחֶ֫קֶת Prov 8:30-31 , plural מְשַׂחֲקִים 2Sam 6:5 +, מְשַׂחֲקוֺת 1Sam 18:7 ; — 1 make sport , Judg 16:25 ( ל person) 2Sam 2:14 ( לִפְנֵי person; in tournament), Prov 8:30 ( לִפְנֵי ), 8:31 ב loc). 2 jest , Prov 26:19 . 3 play: including instrumental music, singing and dancing 1Sam 18:7 , c י ׳לִפְנֵי . 2Sam 6:5 ( ב instrumental), = 1Chr 13:8 ; 2Sam 6:21 ; 1Chr 15:29 ( + מְרַקֵּד ); of merry-making Jer 15:17 (|| עָלַז ), 30:19 ; 31:4 ; of children's sport Zech 8:5 ; of beasts Job 40:20 ; Psa 104:25 ; of man, play with ( ב ) crocod, Job 40:29. Hiph`il (declar.) Participle. plural מַשְׂחִיקִים 2Chr 30:10 they uttered mockery עֲלֵיהֶם (|| מַלְעִנִים ).
